controllerScope: Frozen controller source provenance and actual state/command consumption; no independent transcendental controller oracle.

feedback.scope: Exact saved word differences and the checked recurrence establish this continuation feedback; no trajectory or physical validity bound.

peakRssScope: macOS process lifetime only; not isolated stage or browser/process-tree aggregate, and not an OS memory limit.
zeroSignPolicy: Literal source, stage, ID and consumed-load bindings preserve word strings. Reconstructed rational arithmetic identifies positive and negative zero; derivative zero-sign equality is not claimed.
